name: Smith Machine Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise
aliases: Smith Machine One-Leg Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit on a bench with the bar across the working thigh just above the knee and the foot directly below it.
Steady the bar with both hands, set your free foot aside and release the hooks.
Drive through the ball of your working foot to raise your heel as high as possible, squeezing your calf firmly at the top.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor, rerack safely, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep the bar on your thigh, clear of the kneecap.
Pause briefly at peak contraction instead of bouncing your heel off the floor.
